raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats every timestamp as local, so v2 rows are 6 hours late (CST in January): evening transactions spill into 00:00-06:00 and into 2026-01-19, which skews txn_date across the silver and gold tables. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time fixes this; the sample v2 rows at 12:00 UTC become 06:00 local, which lines up with the legacy rows that start at 06:00.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s"}}
